build_progress_bar_with_tqdm: build a progress bar using tqdm format to display training iteration progress with epoch prefix
build_progress_bar_with_tensorboard: build a progress bar that logs training stats to TensorBoard using a specified log directory
create_json_progress_bar: create a JsonProgressBar to log training stats as JSON objects at regular intervals during iteration
create_wandb_progress_bar_wrapper: create a WandBProgressBarWrapper to log training metrics to Weights and Biases during model training
create_azureml_progress_bar_wrapper: create an AzureMLProgressBarWrapper to log training metrics and configuration to Azure ML runs
